# Nexxovate

> Nexxovate builds enterprise AI platforms, cloud infrastructure and secure digital systems, and provides technology talent and training. Home of Nexyra: network monitoring, an autonomous service desk agent, website auditing and conversational AI.

## Services

- [Enterprise services](https://nexxovate.com/services): IT and managed infrastructure, AI and intelligent automation, cybersecurity and risk protection, digital transformation.
- [AI consultation](https://nexxovate.com/ai-consultation): estate mapping, opportunity assessment, governance design and a measured roadmap for adopting AI.
- [Talent solutions](https://nexxovate.com/talent): engineering talent and specialised technical teams for critical initiatives.
- [Training](https://nexxovate.com/training): upskilling teams in modern technology, AI and cloud engineering.
- [Case studies](https://nexxovate.com/case-studies): results from AI and automation engagements.

## Nexyra products

- [Nexyra overview](https://nexxovate.com/nexyra): the Nexyra enterprise AI ecosystem.
- Network Monitoring: continuous infrastructure telemetry with anomaly correlation and failure prediction.
- AI Service Desk Agent: resolves routine tickets using your runbooks and systems of record, and escalates the hard ones.
- [Website Auditor](https://audit.nexxovate.com/): performance, accessibility, SEO, security and AI-search findings ordered by business impact.
- Nexyra Chat: an assistant grounded in your own documents and data, with cited answers.
